review.reason: The answer is mostly grounded in the passages: they do not define the term, but they do map SI/high-speed PCB flows to IL, crosstalk, eye diagrams, TDR, stackup/TL work, and map oscilloscopes to interface testing and PDN alongside other instruments. Some decision-oriented phrasing is inferred from mappings rather than explicitly stated, but it is a fair and limited reading of the evidence.
